---

# MSBuild Project File Review — ContosoApp Solution

## Summary

| Metric | Value |
|--------|-------|
| Projects | 5 (3 src + 2 test) |
| SDK-style | ✅ All projects are modern SDK-style |
| Directory.Build.props | ❌ Missing |
| Directory.Build.targets | ❌ Missing |
| Central Package Management | ❌ Not adopted |
| Duplicated properties | 7 properties × 5 projects = **35 redundant lines** |
| Duplicated targets | `PrintBuildInfo` × 3 src projects |
| Package version drift | 3 packages with inconsistent versions |

---

## 🔴 Errors (Likely Correctness Issues)

### 1. Package Version Drift — Inconsistent dependency resolution

| Package | Core | Api | Services |
|---------|------|-----|----------|
| `Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions` | 8.0.0 | 8.0.0 | **8.0.1** |

| Package | Core.Tests | Api.Tests |
|---------|-----------|-----------|
| `xunit` | 2.8.1 | **2.7.1** |
| `xunit.runner.visualstudio` | 2.8.1 | **2.5.6** |
| `Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk` | 17.10.0 | **17.9.0** |

**Impact**: Version drift across test projects means tests may pass in one project but fail in another due to behavioral differences. The logging abstractions drift could cause subtle runtime binding issues when Services is loaded by Api (though NuGet will unify upward at restore time, the intent is unclear — was 8.0.1 deliberate?).

---

## 🟡 Warnings (Anti-patterns)

### 2. No Centralized Build Properties (Directory.Build.props missing)

All 5 projects repeat these identical properties:
```xml
<TargetFramework>net8.0</TargetFramework>
<Nullable>enable</Nullable>
<ImplicitUsings>enable</ImplicitUsings>
<TreatWarningsAsErrors>true</TreatWarningsAsErrors>
<EnforceCodeStyleInBuild>true</EnforceCodeStyleInBuild>
<Company>Contoso</Company>
<Authors>Contoso Engineering</Authors>
```

**Problem**: When you need to upgrade to `net9.0`, you must edit 5 files. If one is missed, you get silent incompatibilities.

### 3. Duplicated Custom Target — `PrintBuildInfo`

The identical target appears in all 3 src projects:
```xml
<Target Name="PrintBuildInfo" BeforeTargets="Build">
  <Message Importance="high" Text="Building $(AssemblyName) [$(Configuration)]" />
</Target>
```

**Problem**: If you need to change the message format or add more build-info logging, you must update 3 files identically. This is a classic candidate for `Directory.Build.targets`.

### 4. Duplicated `DocumentationFile` Property

All 3 src projects repeat:
```xml
<DocumentationFile>$(OutputPath)$(AssemblyName).xml</DocumentationFile>
```

This should be centralized with a condition to apply only to non-test projects.

### 5. Scattered Package Versions Without Central Management

With 5 projects and no `Directory.Packages.props`, version governance is manual and error-prone (as evidenced by finding #1).

### 6. `PrintBuildInfo` Target Missing `Inputs`/`Outputs`

The target has no `Inputs`/`Outputs` attributes. While this target only emits a message (so re-execution is harmless), it still runs on every build even when nothing changed. For targets that do real work, this pattern breaks incremental builds.

**Severity here**: Low (message-only target), but establishes a bad pattern that developers may copy for future targets that *do* real work.

---

## 🔵 Suggestions (Maintainability Improvements)

### 7. Multiple PropertyGroups in src projects

Core, Api, and Services split properties into two `<PropertyGroup>` blocks unnecessarily (one for common props, one for `DocumentationFile`). Consolidate into one for readability.

### 8. Test projects should centralize `IsPackable=false`

Both test projects set `<IsPackable>false</IsPackable>`. This can be handled in `Directory.Build.props` with a condition on project path.

---

## 🟢 Positive Observations

- ✅ All projects use SDK-style format — no legacy migration needed
- ✅ `TreatWarningsAsErrors` is enabled everywhere — good discipline
- ✅ `EnforceCodeStyleInBuild` ensures consistent code style
- ✅ `Nullable` is enabled repo-wide
- ✅ No unnecessary explicit file includes (relying on SDK globbing)
- ✅ ProjectReferences are used correctly between layers

---

## Recommended Fix: Proposed File Structure

### 1. `Directory.Build.props` (repo root)

```xml
<Project>

  <PropertyGroup>
    <TargetFramework>net8.0</TargetFramework>
    <Nullable>enable</Nullable>
    <ImplicitUsings>enable</ImplicitUsings>
    <TreatWarningsAsErrors>true</TreatWarningsAsErrors>
    <EnforceCodeStyleInBuild>true</EnforceCodeStyleInBuild>
    <Company>Contoso</Company>
    <Authors>Contoso Engineering</Authors>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <!-- src project defaults -->
  <PropertyGroup Condition="!$(MSBuildProjectName.EndsWith('.Tests'))">
    <DocumentationFile>$(OutputPath)$(AssemblyName).xml</DocumentationFile>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <!-- Test project defaults -->
  <PropertyGroup Condition="$(MSBuildProjectName.EndsWith('.Tests'))">
    <IsPackable>false</IsPackable>
  </PropertyGroup>

</Project>
```

### 2. `Directory.Build.targets` (repo root)

```xml
<Project>

  <!-- Shared build-info target for src projects only -->
  <Target Name="PrintBuildInfo"
          BeforeTargets="Build"
          Condition="!$(MSBuildProjectName.EndsWith('.Tests'))">
    <Message Importance="high" Text="Building $(AssemblyName) [$(Configuration)]" />
  </Target>

</Project>
```

### 3. `Directory.Packages.props` (repo root — Central Package Management)

```xml
<Project>

  <PropertyGroup>
    <ManagePackageVersionsCentrally>true</ManagePackageVersionsCentrally>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <!-- Shared dependencies -->
    <PackageVersion Include="Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions" Version="8.0.1" />
    <PackageVersion Include="System.Text.Json" Version="8.0.5" />
    <PackageVersion Include="Newtonsoft.Json" Version="13.0.3" />
    <PackageVersion Include="Swashbuckle.AspNetCore" Version="6.5.0" />

    <!-- Test dependencies -->
    <PackageVersion Include="Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk" Version="17.10.0" />
    <PackageVersion Include="xunit" Version="2.8.1" />
    <PackageVersion Include="xunit.runner.visualstudio" Version="2.8.1" />
    <PackageVersion Include="NSubstitute" Version="5.1.0" />
  </ItemGroup>

</Project>
```

### 4. Simplified Project Files After Refactoring

**`src/ContosoApp.Core/ContosoApp.Core.csproj`** (from 26 → 8 lines):
```xml
<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk">

  <ItemGroup>
    <PackageReference Include="Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions" />
    <PackageReference Include="System.Text.Json" />
  </ItemGroup>

</Project>
```

**`src/ContosoApp.Api/ContosoApp.Api.csproj`** (from 32 → 14 lines):
```xml
<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Web">

  <ItemGroup>
    <PackageReference Include="Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions" />
    <PackageReference Include="Swashbuckle.AspNetCore" />
    <PackageReference Include="System.Text.Json" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <ProjectReference Include="..\ContosoApp.Core\ContosoApp.Core.csproj" />
    <ProjectReference Include="..\ContosoApp.Services\ContosoApp.Services.csproj" />
  </ItemGroup>

</Project>
```

**`src/ContosoApp.Services/ContosoApp.Services.csproj`** (from 30 → 12 lines):
```xml
<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk">

  <ItemGroup>
    <PackageReference Include="Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions" />
    <PackageReference Include="Newtonsoft.Json" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <ProjectReference Include="..\ContosoApp.Core\ContosoApp.Core.csproj" />
  </ItemGroup>

</Project>
```

**`test/ContosoApp.Core.Tests/ContosoApp.Core.Tests.csproj`** (from 25 → 14 lines):
```xml
<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk">

  <ItemGroup>
    <PackageReference Include="Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk" />
    <PackageReference Include="xunit" />
    <PackageReference Include="xunit.runner.visualstudio" />
    <PackageReference Include="NSubstitute" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <ProjectReference Include="..\..\src\ContosoApp.Core\ContosoApp.Core.csproj" />
  </ItemGroup>

</Project>
```

---

## Impact Summary

| Metric | Before | After | Improvement |
|--------|--------|-------|-------------|
| Total XML lines (all .csproj) | ~139 | ~56 | **60% reduction** |
| Files to edit for TFM upgrade | 5 | 1 | **80% fewer** |
| Package version locations | 12 scattered | 1 centralized | **Single source of truth** |
| Version drift risk | High | Eliminated | ✅ |
| Custom target copies | 3 | 1 | **Single definition** |

---

## Migration Steps

1. **Create `Directory.Packages.props`** first — align all versions upward (use latest of each drifted pair)
2. **Create `Directory.Build.props`** — move shared properties
3. **Create `Directory.Build.targets`** — move `PrintBuildInfo` target
4. **Strip duplicated content** from each `.csproj`
5. **Remove `Version=` attributes** from all `<PackageReference>` elements (CPM requires this)
6. **Build & test** — run `dotnet build` and `dotnet test` to verify equivalence
7. **Commit atomically** — all changes in one commit so bisect works
